Looks like that will be so good. What's your prefered beverage with it?
I'm diabetic so my only available beverages are whisky water and black coffee, I'd recommend any of them depending on the time of day.

Had to go out and buy a big sterilite bin that would fit the Pike, it will forever be my fish brining bin from now on.

The brine is basic, it's about 3 Liters of water, a half cup each of soy sauce and worcestersghire sauce, about 1/4 cup of coarse salt, some black and white pepper, garlic powder and onion salt, probably a couple teaspoons of each. I let it soak in the brine for about 6 hours, 3 would probably be fine too.

I took it out of the brine, rinsed it in cold water and patted it dry with paper towel as best I could then set it outside to wind dry for a while until it was tacky to the touch.

Then I set up the BBQ with a daisy chain of briquettes with soaked wood chips scattered about them and lit it from one end so that each briquette would burn and light the next so that it provides a slow and cool burn, I want the smoke not the heat. I'm not sure what temperature it's smoking at because it doesn't even register on the grills thermometer but it's 0C outside and I want as close to that as possible.
